records.description: How patient records are sourced, stored, and displayed
records.sourcesDescription: Where the patient records shown in temetro come from
records.clinicDbDesc: Patient records are stored in your clinic's own database and scoped to this clinic.

records.retentionBody: Records are kept for as long as your clinic exists. Deleting a patient permanently removes their chart from the clinic database, and the activity log keeps an audit trail of every change — who made it and when.

developers.description: Access tokens for the temetro API

developers.tokensDescription: Long-lived tokens for scripts and integrations
developers.resourcesBody: The API reference — covering patients, appointments, prescriptions, tasks, messaging, activity and analytics — lives in the project documentation under docs/api. temetro is open source, so the route handlers in backend/src/routes are the authoritative spec.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: Control who in your clinic can use the AI assistant. When disabled, the AI page and sidebar entry are hidden and the assistant cannot be reached.
availability.enabledHint: Turn the AI assistant on for your clinic. Off hides it for everyone.
availability.employeesOnlyHint: Hide the AI from staff; owners and admins keep access.
availability.savedBody: The change applies across your clinic.
availability.readonlyEnabled: The AI assistant is enabled for your clinic.
availability.readonlyEmployeesOnly: The AI assistant is restricted to owners and admins.
availability.readonlyDisabled: The AI assistant is disabled for your clinic.

ai.modeDescription: Choose how temetro runs the AI. A cloud API key sends data off your infrastructure; a local model keeps everything on your machine.
ai.modeApiHint: Requests go to your chosen provider. Patient identifiers are de-identified by Veil before they leave.
ai.modeLocalHint: Requests run against a model on your own infrastructure. No patient data leaves the clinic.
ai.providerDescription: Your key is encrypted at rest and never shown again. You can store a key per provider and switch between them.
ai.apiKeyHint: The key is encrypted before storage and used only to call the provider.
ai.localDescription: Point temetro at your Ollama server. The model runs on your infrastructure, so patient data never leaves the clinic.
ai.veilDescription: Veil de-identifies patient information before it is sent to an external model, then restores it in the response.
ai.veilApiNote: Veil applies to every external request. Identifiers are replaced with tokens the model never sees, and re-inserted before you read the answer.
ai.veilLocalNote: You are in local mode, so patient data never leaves your infrastructure and Veil is not needed.
ai.savedBody: Your AI configuration has been updated.
ai.saveFailedBody: Saving your AI settings failed. Please try again.
